description: Loosely tracks an opponent stone on the centre cell of the 4th row (row 3, col 3), never mine, with opponent stones under it at (row 2, col 3) or (row 2, col 4), the cell to its left (row 3, col 2) still empty and (row 3, col 5) not theirs. Strongest when the opponent has a 2x2 block in the centre (rows 2-3, cols 3-4). Many boards with these stones stay silent; far-away stones also shift it.
effect: Small: when strongly active it slightly lowers the probability of column 3 (and 4) by about 2-7 points; forcing it to zero barely changes the move.
notes: Hypotheses: their (3,3)+(2,4) diagonal (F1 0.28); +row-3 constraints (0.33); hand-set cell weights from single-cell histograms (0.33, AUROC 0.72); poisoned column (their threat above a landing cell, 0.13); final rule p5 F1 0.337 (P 0.26, R 0.50), AUROC 0.73. Minimal pairs: my stone at (3,3) always kills it and theirs boosts it, but the same centre stones in isolation (e.g. 3,4,3,3,4,4,0,3) do not fire, and stones at (3,1),(4,1) add about 1.5. Looks distributed or mixed. Simulation share nan (the unit has almost no causal effect). Synthesis reaches 10.0-10.6 vs dev max 9.56.
